name: VSN F-104C Starfighter (standalone)
summary: VSN team's free standalone F-104C Starfighter with custom EFM and clickable cockpit.
description:
Free standalone VSN F-104C Starfighter with a custom flight model and clickable cockpit, released as early access (V0.99) in June 2025.

VSN's downloads are on pCloud and ask for a password; VSN publishes it on their download index: `VSNROX`.
